submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O phases (MgO, MgSb2O6 trirutile, Sb oxides) are wide-gap insulators and should absorb almost nothing at 2.4 eV, so I expected little or no photoresponse anywhere on the line. I spread the 5 EQE measurements across it: indices 0, 10, 16, 22 (MgSb2O6 stoichiometry) and 27. All gave EQE of about 0 (±0.0006%), which is noise level. Index 10 (Sb 0.26) had the highest nominal value, 0.00024%, but it is not meaningfully different from the others.
